authority.exactRetry: reuses the one retained Profile-bound command or declaration byte-for-byte
authority.reconnectBehavior: updates connection presentation only; the user must explicitly choose exact retry
authority.definitiveClientRejection: a terminal 4xx clears only the matching exact retry payload
authority.acceptedReplay: adopts returned authoritative resources and cannot consume, move, equip, or apply the result twice
authority.malformedRecoveryPayload: strict parsing removes the malformed payload and never submits it

coveredFlows: Trainer inventory Equip, Give, Transfer, Split, Merge, and Discard
shared inventory Transfer, Split, Merge, and Discard
Trainer and shared inventory item use
Trainer equipment custody and lifecycle commands

recoveryStorage.scope: one exact Trainer or shared-inventory scope
recoveryStorage.durability: strict payload is mirrored to same-tab session storage and origin-local durable storage until terminal resolution
recoveryStorage.crossTab: storage events make the matching flow uncertain in every open tab; a scope lock rejects a competing flow
recoveryStorage.browserRestart: the exact payload is restored from durable origin-local storage and remirrored into the active tab
forbiddenVisibleFields: stable inventory row or source-instance ID
raw command, declaration, lock, or ownership evidence

uncertain.offline: exact retry stays visible but disabled with a textual reconnection reason
uncertain.profileMismatch: exact retry stays disabled until the original Profile is selected
uncertain.crossTabTerminalSignal: transition to conflict and require authoritative reload

causes: another tab resolved the retained command
another exact flow already owns the scope recovery lock
conflict.permittedAction: reload authoritative inventory without submitting a mutation
conflict.selectionPolicy: discard stale local selection and request fresh server-issued offers only after reload

accepted.adoption: replace affected local resources from accepted response or authoritative reload
accepted.history: the existing authoritative journal remains the receipt source

reservations.projection: server-issued offers expose only unreserved quantity and textual unavailable reasons
reservations.presentation: reserved-stack reasons are visible beside row controls rather than tooltip-only
reservations.reconciliation: a reservation change invalidates the stale offer and requires a current projection

interaction.systemLayer: uncertainty and conflict use one matte System card, never a gameplay choice
uncertainCopy: Inventory actions are locked until this result is resolved.
The original action is retained. No new inventory action will be created.
interaction.conflictCopy: the selected row may have moved, changed quantity, or become reserved
nonColourCues: warning, connection, shield, and lock icons

Offline, Online, Locked, and disabled-reason text
amber or danger signal spine plus structural border
explicit exact-retry or authoritative-reload action label
interaction.responsive: inventory and System card reflow to one column without horizontal page overflow
interaction.focus: recovery heading receives focus when state changes; enabled recovery action has a cyan focus outline
